# camera-controls 1.33.0 (patched)

`camera-controls-1.33.0-9164f63.tgz` is [yomotsu/camera-controls](https://github.com/yomotsu/camera-controls)
1.33.0 with Oncyber's patches for three.js r187 (commit `9164f63`). It is MIT
licensed (see `LICENSE` inside the tarball). The frontend installs it with
`"camera-controls": "file:../vendor/camera-controls/…"`, so installs need no
access to a fork on GitHub.

To rebuild it, check out the patched source, then run
`npm pack --ignore-scripts` and replace the tarball here.
